svg.aria-label: A commitment card template for men and boys attending an accountability session. Six commitments, each with a tick box: I will not arrange or bless a marriage involving anyone under eighteen. I will pay school fees before discretionary spending. I will do a named share of the care work at home. I will not repeat talk that shames a girl, and I will ask about the man. I will accompany a referral without taking over the decision. I will buy from women-led businesses at a fair price. Below, three lines to be completed: one thing I will do this month, who will ask me about it, and by when. Signed and dated, with a note that the card is a promise to a household, not to the centre.
svg.text: Accountability session · Treasured Vessels Girls’ Centre, Jinja
I will not arrange, attend or bless a marriage involving anyone under 18.
I will pay school fees before discretionary spending.
I will do a named share of the care work at home — not “help”.
I will not repeat talk that shames a girl, and I will ask about the man.
I will accompany a referral without taking over the decision.
I will buy from women-led businesses, at a fair price.
MAKE IT SPECIFIC — A PROMISE NOBODY CAN CHECK IS NOT A PROMISE
One thing I will do this month
Who will ask me about it
This card is a promise to your household and your community — not to the centre. Nobody will collect it.
